notablePrerequisites: Tree of Perdition does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Tree of Perdition, exchanging target opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Cast Into the Maw of Hell for {4}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing thirteen damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 20 damage to target opponent.
